preconditions.description: The input S is a string.
The length of S is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c == '?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Every character in S is either a lowercase English letter or '?'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all((return_value == sum(abs(ord(T[i]) - ord(T[i+1])) for i in range(len(T)-1))) for T in [S.replace('?', 'a') if False else None]))
postconditions.description: If return_value is -1, no valid palindrome can be formed. Otherwise, return_value is the minimum possible sum of absolute differences of adjacent characters among all valid palindromic completions of S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and any(all((T[i] == T[-1-i] for i in range(len(T))) and all((c.islower() for c in T)) and all((S[i] == '?' or S[i] == T[i] for i in range(len(S)))) for T in [None]))
postconditions.description: If return_value is not -1, there exists at least one string T that is a palindrome, consists only of lowercase letters, matches S where S is not '?', and achieves the sum return_value.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all((sum(abs(ord(T[i]) - ord(T[i+1])) for i in range(len(T)-1)) >= return_value) for T in [None] if False))
postconditions.description: If return_value is not -1, it is the global minimum sum of absolute differences of adjacent characters over all valid palindromic completions of S.
